title: Product page
summary: Product detail (PDP) composed from the storefront header + commerce-product-detail + commerce-product-features + commerce-reviews + optional closing CTA + footer.
brief: Build the product detail page (PDP): marketing-header for storefront nav, commerce-product-detail for the gallery + name + price + add-to-cart, commerce-product-features for the materials / construction spotlight, commerce-reviews for social proof, an optional marketing-cta closing band (gift card, cross-sell), and marketing-footer.

sections.intent: Storefront top nav with brand + categories + cart.
Star summary + individual reviews — social proof.

layout: Stack sections vertically in declared order — the PDP scrolls top-to-bottom. Detail first (above the fold), then features, then reviews. Drop the closing CTA when there's nothing relevant to promote. Each section installs as its own file — import a block from `@/components/ui/<section.block>` (e.g. `import { CommerceProductDetail } from "@/components/ui/commerce-product-detail"`).

checklist.check: [MarketingHeader] Avoid: Passing more than ~5 links — the inline row gets crowded; group secondary items under the CTA or a footer.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Putting raw tags in actions instead of , losing button styling.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Forgetting the logo links to '/' — wrap the logo node in an anchor.

[MarketingHeader] A11y: The mobile toggle is a <button> with aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at the panel and an aria-label that flips between 'Open menu' / 'Close menu'. Links are real anchors, keyboard-focusable, with visible focus rings.
[CommerceProductDetail] Avoid: Hard-coding option selectors into the block — pass them as the options slot so selection state stays with the consumer.
[CommerceProductDetail] Avoid: Missing alt text on the gallery image describing the product.
[CommerceProductDetail] Avoid: Putting price in the name field — keep price separate so its larger styling applies.

[CommerceProductDetail] A11y: The product name renders as the page <h1>. The block is layout; option controls and buttons you pass must carry their own labels. Gallery images need descriptive alt text.
[CommerceProductFeatures] Avoid: Three+ alternating rows that all look the same — mix in copy length, image crop, or add a grid section to break the rhythm.
[CommerceProductFeatures] Avoid: Tiny icons in 'grid' that look like noise — use 24px glyphs sized to the size-5 well.
[CommerceProductFeatures] Avoid: Forgetting alt text on feature media — these are informative, not decorative.

[CommerceProductFeatures] A11y: Section title is <h2>; per-feature titles render as <h3>. The alternating order flip is purely visual — source order stays top-to-bottom, so screen readers reach features in declared order regardless of which side the image is on.
[CommerceReviews] Avoid: Passing a rating outside 0–5 — it's clamped, but supply real values so the stars are accurate.
[CommerceReviews] Avoid: Relying on star color alone to convey the rating — pair it with the numeric '4.5 out of 5' text (the summary does this).
[CommerceReviews] Avoid: Omitting the author, leaving reviews unattributed.

[CommerceReviews] A11y: Star rows are decorative (aria-hidden); the numeric 'X out of 5' text carries the rating for assistive tech. The section title is an <h2> and review titles are <h3>, preserving heading order.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: On variant='panel', passing a primary <Button> — it disappears against the primary background; use variant='secondary' or 'outline'.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: Omitting actions entirely — a CTA with no button is just a heading.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: Stacking multiple panel CTAs, creating competing focal points.
[MarketingCta] A11y: Renders an <h2>, keeping it below the hero's <h1>. On variant='panel', button contrast must clear WCAG against the primary fill — prefer secondary/outline buttons.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: One column with 20 links instead of a few grouped columns — group by topic.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Omitting the copyright line, which most footers are expected to carry.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Putting social icons with no accessible label — wrap each in a link with an aria-label or sr-only text.

[MarketingFooter] A11y: Each column title renders as an <h3>. Links are real anchors with visible hover/focus states. Social icon links need an accessible name (aria-label or sr-only text) since the icon alone isn't announced.
